mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (account_id, ticker, side, quantity, price, order_type, status, received_at, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{ticker}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{orderType}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, account_id AS accountId, ticker, side, quantity, price, order_type AS orderType, status, received_at AS receivedAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, executed_price AS executedPrice, executed_on AS executedOn FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT order_id AS orderId, account_id AS accountId, ticker, side, quantity, price, order_type AS orderType, status, received_at AS receivedAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, executed_price AS executedPrice, executed_on AS executedOn FROM orders WHERE order_id = CAST(REPLACE(#{id}, 'ORD-', '') AS BIGINT)
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE order_id = CAST(REPLACE(#{id}, 'ORD-', '') AS BIGINT) AND status = 'NEW'
